_: Pre-registered evaluation matrix. Run in four cold-browser chunks rather than one invocation; see gate-notes below. Case list, per-case expectation and rubric unchanged.
gateNotes: A single invocation of all twelve cases wedged reproducibly after the fifth heavy render session (the CDP client has no socket-close rejection, so a lost page target hangs the harness forever). Each chunk below is its own Chrome with its own profile, and every case still clears every 27b: key before it runs, so the chunking is strictly colder than one browser for twelve cases.
webglRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2, Unspecified Version)

billing.note: Root-tileset requests are the billable unit. 1,000/month free, $6.00/1,000 after. The noimagery case's request is counted here but blocked in the browser, so it never reaches Google.
